status: Confirmed in source; runtime needs test
finding: Auto style routing supports explicit handbag/wallet/backpack subtype conditions, but product-name matching is keyword-based and only applies the detailed subtype routing when product_type is bag.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_resolve_auto_style
effect: If Telegram category/subcategory values are inconsistent or a product name uses an unrecognised synonym, a bag can fall back to a generic bag style or wrong subtype candidates.
recommended_action: Normalize subtype labels and synonyms in one mapping function; validate selected style against subtype before prompt assembly.
test_case: Bonia handbag; Bonia wallet; laptop backpack; tote bag; crossbody sling; card holder.

status: Confirmed in main; candidate patch needs correction
finding: Main slices style template to 70 characters, setting to 100, camera to 70 and concept to 100. The open audit patch replaces slices with _prompt_sentence, but that helper returns a generic fallback when the first full sentence exceeds the limit; many style templates have first sentences longer than 70 characters, so the chosen style direction can disappear rather than be summarized.
evidence: main prompt_engine.py output uses style_template[:70], scene[:100], camera[:70], concept[:100]; audit/prompt-truncation-category-match-20261020 _prompt_sentence returns fallback if the first sentence exceeds limit.
effect: Production can lose most of the selected style; the proposed patch avoids fragments but may replace detailed style directions with a generic sentence.
recommended_action: Summarize long instructions semantically or retain a complete first sentence even when slightly over limit; do not replace a valid style with a generic fallback merely because the sentence is long. Add output tests for every style.
test_case: Generate prompts with cinematic, handbag_showcase, wallet_daily_carry and beauty_macro before/after the patch; verify each retains its distinctive direction.

status: Confirmed in source
finding: Raw string slicing can cut a sentence mid-word or mid-sentence; the existing patch branch introduces _prompt_sentence for several fields, but this must be checked for every path and should be combined with sensible content limits.
evidence: main prompt_engine.py: style_template[:70], str(scene)[:100], camera[:70], concept[:100]; audit/prompt-truncation-category-match branch replaces some with _prompt_sentence.
effect: Fragments such as 'No capacity, durability or security...' can be emitted without the complete constraint.
recommended_action: Use a shared sentence-aware truncation helper across every prompt path, then run generated-output regression tests; avoid merely moving the cut to a sentence boundary if it removes the core instruction.
test_case: Long style, setting, camera and concept; custom universal category; storyboard and non-storyboard modes.

status: Needs intentional-alias decision
finding: Three universal framework style keys do not exist in STYLES: luxury_reveal, zoom, detail_macro. Framework lookup returns the first framework as fallback if no exact key matches.
evidence: prompts/universal_prompt_templates.json style_keys compared with prompt_catalog.py STYLES; _universal_prompt_direction fallback
effect: A style can silently receive the premium framework even if the intended direction was camera movement or detail focus.
recommended_action: Map each key to an existing canonical style or define it explicitly; avoid silent first-framework fallback for unknown keys.
test_case: Call _universal_prompt_direction for each referenced key, including luxury_reveal, zoom and detail_macro; assert the expected framework id.

status: Confirmed in source
finding: Many category hooks use the same generic imperative pattern, e.g. TENGOK BEG INI, TENGOK KASUT INI, TENGOK TELEFON INI; the wording is not varied by angle or product detail.
evidence: prompt_catalog.py HOOKS dictionary
effect: Openings can sound repetitive and low-value across different products; the phrase may be spoken even when it does not fit the chosen voice/style.
recommended_action: Create a small curated set of natural Bahasa Melayu Malaysia hooks per category and ad angle; rotate wording without inventing benefits, urgency, prices or popularity.
test_case: Compare ten different products in the same category and across categories; check for repetitive first line and unsupported claims.

status: Potential cross-path conflict; confirm all callers
finding: build_prompt accepts prompt_language and passes it to _build_single_prompt, but the visible final prompt suffix unconditionally says a selected voice should use Bahasa Melayu Malaysia. The shown _build_single_prompt body does not use prompt_language to choose speech language.
evidence: prompt_engine.py build_prompt/_build_single_prompt signatures and final prompt suffix
effect: English voice selection may be overridden by a generic Malay instruction on some paths.
recommended_action: Thread prompt_language into the final spoken-copy instruction and make the language explicit; inspect callers and generated prompts before changing.
test_case: Run same product in Malay and English voice modes; assert prompt language differs correctly and only selected language is requested.

status: Partially confirmed
finding: Category actions and SFX have 10 groups, while product categories in the style map are broader. Several categories fall into home/general or gadget groups; travel is grouped with bag and pet/accessory-like items may fall to general.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_creative_variation, _CREATIVE_ACTIONS, _SFX_BY_TYPE
effect: A category may get a technically plausible but generic or mismatched action/SFX; a travel product may be treated like a bag.
recommended_action: Keep common rules shared but map every supported category/subcategory to an intentional action/audio profile; use generic only as a clear fallback.
test_case: Test toy, baby, furniture, garden, kitchen appliance, travel luggage, jewellery, automotive and pet products.

status: Likely conflict; output sampling required
finding: Camera direction is assembled separately from style templates, category actions and storyboard scene directions; several of these independently prescribe push-ins, slides, tracking or close-ups.
evidence: prompt_engine.py: CAMERAS, style templates, _CREATIVE_ACTIONS, _category_specific_scenes and prompt assembly
effect: Prompt can prescribe multiple moves within the same beat, contrary to the intended one-action/one-camera-move rule.
recommended_action: Treat style as visual look, camera as one selected move, and action as subject movement; run a conflict check or compose them into one shot direction.
test_case: Inspect generated prompts for each camera choice across fashion, bag, gadget and home; count incompatible simultaneous camera moves.

status: Confirmed rule overlap; behavior needs test
finding: Global rules prohibit unrequested on-screen text, while the white_doodle template permits selected verified hook/feature labels in some paths; different branches describe overlays differently.
evidence: prompt_catalog.py white_doodle template; prompt_engine.py white_doodle rules; prompts/universal_prompt_templates.json global_rules
effect: A generator may add text labels even where the user expected only animated doodles, or may suppress intended doodle features due to blanket no-text wording.
recommended_action: Separate non-text doodle graphics from text overlays; allow text only through an explicit user choice and a verified-text field.
test_case: Test white_doodle with text disabled and enabled; confirm no random labels, logos or captions.

status: Confirmed in source inventory
finding: Detailed five-beat scene templates exist for fashion, hijab, shoes, bag, beauty and gadget, with conditional templates for beds and cookware sets. Other categories use more generic fallback scenes.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_category_specific_scenes and scenes_by_type
effect: Products such as toys, pet goods, garden tools, jewellery, stationery, travel gear and baby products may receive less distinctive scenes.
recommended_action: Add templates only where a category has distinct safe actions; otherwise improve generic fallback with one category-aware interaction and visible-detail beat.
test_case: Compare scene beat outputs for a handbag, lamp, toy, baby product, jewellery, stationery, pet accessory and gardening tool.

status: Not audited in this scope
finding: Prompt source inventory alone does not prove that the selected human/animal model is suitable for the product age/category; the model-selector and Telegram choice path are outside this prompt-library check.
evidence: Scope limitation: audited prompt_catalog.py, prompt_engine.py and universal_prompt_templates.json only
effect: Adult clothing could be shown on an unsuitable model, or child clothing could inherit an adult persona if upstream selection is wrong.
recommended_action: Audit model selector and UI-to-prompt arguments as a separate path; preserve existing intended category defaults and add validation.
test_case: Child clothing/shoes, adult men's fashion, hijab, pet products and products with no human model.

status: Not verified
finding: This inventory was extracted from repository source files; the production SQLite database loaded through KLIPPO_PROMPT_DB was not read or compared row-by-row.
evidence: audit/prompt-database/README.md scope note; prompt_catalog.py DB_PATH/connect
effect: Source defaults may differ from active production rows because SQLite seeding is additive and preserves existing/customized rows.
recommended_action: Export the actual active storyboard_prompt_styles rows from the configured production DB in a safe, read-only way, then compare style_key, display_name, template, version and active against source defaults.
test_case: Compare count, missing/extra keys, template hashes, inactive rows and customized rows without modifying production.

status: Needs generated-output test
finding: For split clips, continuation behavior is spread across _build_single_prompt and _creative_variation; part indices and handoff instructions must remain aligned for 20s/30s requests.
evidence: prompt_engine.py: build_prompt parts range and part-specific branches
effect: Part 2 may repeat a hook or mismatch its first-frame continuity if one branch interprets part numbering differently.
recommended_action: Standardize part numbering (zero- or one-based) and generate regression samples for each supported duration.
test_case: Check 20s two-part and 30s three-part output; Part 1 holds final frame, next part continues without repeating hook.

status: Confirmed architecture concern
finding: The prompt combines identity rules, category directions, natural motion, framing, scene actions, style template, timed storyboard, creative variation, audio and quality rules; repeated instructions can compete for model attention.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_build_single_prompt and _creative_variation
effect: Long prompts can bury the most important requirements and duplicate instructions instead of strengthening them.
recommended_action: Compose a hierarchy: product lock; selected style; five-beat storyboard; one camera move/action per beat; selected voice/audio; short negative constraints. Remove repeated constraints only after regression tests.
test_case: Measure final prompt length and detect repeated/conflicting instructions across common styles and categories.

status: Needs end-to-end check
finding: Prompt inventory has English technical direction strings and Malay hook text; this is acceptable for many video models only if the selected spoken language and UI labels are separately clear and consistent.
evidence: prompt_engine.py templates; prompt_catalog.py hooks; user requirement for Bahasa Melayu Malaysia speech
effect: English instruction text itself is not necessarily a defect, but spoken copy may use the wrong language or sound unnatural if language selection is not propagated.
recommended_action: Keep technical instructions in one chosen prompt language if desired, but explicitly separate prompt instruction language from spoken-audio language and enforce Malaysian Malay wording for Malay speech.
test_case: Test Malay and English modes with Northern/Malaysian phrasing constraints; reject Indonesian wording and mixed-language spoken lines unless selected.

status: Partially confirmed
finding: The current audit checker flags missing framework keys, but an unknown key can fall through to the first framework without reporting a runtime error.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_universal_prompt_direction; framework_style_key_check.csv
effect: Inventory can show an error while runtime silently produces a plausible but wrong result.
recommended_action: Add a validation test that fails for unregistered keys unless they are in an explicit alias map.
test_case: Assert all framework style keys resolve to exactly one canonical style or intentional alias.

area: Adegan khusus kategori tidak sampai ke laluan biasa
status: Confirmed and patched in PR #131; CI passes
finding: For common 10-second storyboard prompts and split 20s/30s clips, _build_single_prompt returned from its early timing branch before the later _category_specific_scenes block ran. The common output therefore used generic timing beats instead of the stored category-specific scene titles and directions.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_build_single_prompt early return and _category_specific_scenes; reproduced by existing tests and corrected in PR #131.
effect: Category-specific scene inventory existed but many ordinary prompts did not use it, causing repetitive generic video structures.
recommended_action: Build the five timed beats from _category_specific_scenes in the common branch; for continuation clips use a continuity bridge plus category-specific action/detail, without repeating the opening hook.
test_case: Handbag should include HOOK / BAG SHAPE and HARDWARE / SEAM DETAIL; cookware should show the complete set and plausible use; White Doodle must preserve final-frame hold and no-contour-yet rule.

area: Arahan pembukaan dan hook bercanggah dengan bahasa suara English
status: Confirmed and patched in PR #131; latest commit checks pending confirmation
finding: opening_direction() always appended an instruction to speak Bahasa Melayu Malaysia, and one random voice recipe also named Bahasa Melayu Malaysia. product_hook() generated Malay spoken lines even when prompt_language was English, creating contradictory directions in the same prompt.
evidence: prompt_catalog.py: opening_direction(), OPENING_VOICE_STYLES, product_hook(); prompt_engine.py calls both helpers from the storyboard path.
effect: English selection could still yield a Malay-only voice instruction or Malay quoted hook, reducing output language consistency.
recommended_action: Pass selected language to opening_direction() and product_hook(); use neutral selected-language voice recipe; produce English product-name/category hook variants when English is selected.
test_case: Regression tests assert English openings and hooks contain English instructions and no Malay hook phrase.

area: Frasa hook dalam pangkalan data tidak digunakan untuk hook kategori fallback
status: Confirmed and patched in PR #131; latest commit checks pending confirmation
finding: product_hook() loaded curated hooks from storyboard_hooks and used them to identify a category, but after that it returned a separate set of generic category phrases instead of any stored hook. This made custom or curated category hook wording ineffective when the product name was missing.
evidence: prompt_catalog.py:product_hook(); selected category rows provide keywords and hooks, but the Malay fallback now returns the selected stored hook in normalized sentence case.
effect: Reviewers could edit or curate database hook rows without seeing their wording in the generated prompt.
recommended_action: Return a selected stored category hook for Malay when a product name is unavailable; keep the selected-language English fallback and retain product-name-based hooks when a name is supplied.
test_case: Test that a stored category hook is used, is not shouted in all caps, and still respects the selected speech language.

area: Pemetaan framework universal mengandungi gaya berulang dan satu gaya tidak sepadan
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: premium_showcase repeated luxury, camera_reveal repeated dynamic, and detail_focus included studio_360_safe even though that key is already matched earlier to camera_reveal. The missing detail_macro key had been replaced with a style that did not preserve the intended macro-focus meaning.
evidence: prompts/universal_prompt_templates.json: frameworks premium_showcase, camera_reveal and detail_focus; prompt_engine.py:_universal_prompt_direction returns the first framework containing the selected key.
effect: Some selected styles could route to an earlier, different framework than the list placement implied; duplicate candidates added no useful variation.
recommended_action: Remove duplicate keys and remove the semantically mismatched studio_360_safe entry from detail_focus; retain valid macro/detail keys already present.
test_case: Re-run canonical key checks and inspect framework selection for beauty_macro, bag_detail_macro, studio_360_safe and dynamic.

area: Adegan 5-beat khusus hanya meliputi sebahagian kategori produk
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: The common prompt path used _category_specific_scenes(), but its bespoke scene map covered only fashion, hijab, shoes, bag, beauty, food and gadget. Other menu categories such as equipment, home, accessory, toy, book_stationery, sports, pet, automotive, baby, travel and office fell through to generic beats.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_category_specific_scenes(); compared against PRODUCT_TYPES in bot.py.
effect: Prompts for many products could repeat the same generic action/detail structure despite having separate category choices and source directions.
recommended_action: Add five-beat category-specific scene plans for every top-level product category, plus supported kitchen, furniture, garden and crafts types; add a regression test preventing menu categories from falling back to generic beats.
test_case: Inspect representative prompt outputs for pet, baby, sports, office, automotive and equipment after CI passes.

area: Pembaikan pemotongan ayat masih membuang arahan penting selepas ayat pertama
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: The first sentence was no longer cut mid-sentence, but _prompt_sentence() still returned only the first sentence whenever a style, scene, camera direction or concept exceeded its target length. That silently discarded later constraints, such as the orbit camera rule not to reveal unseen sides and style-specific safety notes.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_prompt_sentence() and prompt assembly of style_template, scene, camera and concept.
effect: Prompts looked syntactically complete but omitted later user instructions or safety constraints.
recommended_action: Use whitespace-normalized complete text for the selected style, scene, camera and concept, and explicitly state that the selected camera instruction overrides conflicting style movement.
test_case: Add a regression test that checks the second sentence of style, scene, camera and concept survives in the generated prompt.

area: Arahan hook dan CTA automatik boleh bercanggah dengan skrip suara tepat pengguna
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: prompt_engine.py added a generic instruction to use a short product-specific hook and CTA whenever voice was enabled, while bot.py also adds the exact user-supplied script when voiceover_mode is script. This can encourage the video model to append extra speech despite the selected exact script.
evidence: prompt_engine.py final voice instructions; bot.py:prompt_creative_settings() script branch and prompt assembly.
effect: Generated speech could add unrequested hook/CTA lines around a script the user expected to be reproduced exactly.
recommended_action: Change engine wording to request hook/CTA only for AI-generated voice; when a user script is selected, preserve it exactly and add no dialogue. Let prompt_creative_settings() control whether voice is absent, AI-generated or scripted.
test_case: Regression test asserts the prompt does not require generic hook/CTA in place of a user-supplied script.

area: Pilihan framing kamera turut dipotong selepas ayat pertama
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: bot.py split the selected PRODUCT_FRAMING direction at the first '. ' and appended only the first sentence. Several framing options place critical restrictions in sentence two, such as no full body, no phone/mirror selfie, vehicle must remain stationary, or do not invent details.
evidence: bot.py: prompt generation block applying PRODUCT_FRAMING.
effect: Selected framing could lose the very constraints that distinguish it from a generic shot, causing camera/model behavior to contradict the selected option.
recommended_action: Preserve the complete selected framing direction after whitespace normalization instead of splitting at the first sentence.
test_case: Check detail, shoes_car, gadget_screen, bag_open and other multi-sentence framing options in prompt output.

area: Auto gaya beg membiarkan kata kunci nama produk mengatasi subkategori pilihan pengguna
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: _resolve_auto_style() checked wallet terms in the product name before checking an explicit subtype. A product selected as bag_handbag but with the word 'wallet' somewhere in its name could be routed to wallet styles, overriding the user's explicit category choice.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_resolve_auto_style(); bot.py passes prompt_product_subcategory into build_prompt().
effect: A correct explicit subcategory could still generate an incompatible style, repeating the handbag-versus-wallet mismatch.
recommended_action: Prioritize explicit wallet/backpack/handbag/sling/tote subcategories; only infer from product-name words when no explicit subtype resolves the category.
test_case: Regression test checks explicit bag_handbag and bag_wallet selections even when the product name contains conflicting keywords.

area: Pilihan umur model kanak-kanak boleh mengatasi kesesuaian produk bayi
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: _prompt_is_child_product() classifies all baby-category products as child products. In prompt_creative_settings(), a selected child age therefore entered the generic child-model branch and could request a 4–17-year-old model for baby-feeding, bathing, sleep or other infant products.
evidence: bot.py:_prompt_is_child_product() and prompt_creative_settings() model branch ordering.
effect: The generated model could be age-inappropriate for infant products even though the selected product category indicates baby use.
recommended_action: Prioritize baby-product handling: if a child/teen age is selected, use adult caregiver hands or product-only display; if an adult age is selected, use a supervised adult caregiver model.
test_case: Check that baby product rules are applied before generic child-product rules and preserve the user's selected adult model settings.

area: Pilihan bertudung/tidak bertudung tidak dimasukkan dalam arahan video untuk satu model
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: prompt_creative_settings() used the selected gender, appearance and age for a single human model but omitted prompt_model_hijab. The hijab choice was only appended in the two-model cast branch; a single-model video could therefore ignore the user's selected head covering.
evidence: bot.py:prompt_creative_settings() and prompt model selection flow.
effect: The image prompt could respect the selected hijab choice while the video prompt did not, breaking continuity between image and video prompts.
recommended_action: Append the selected hijab/no-hijab instruction to single-model video settings when a female model is selected; skip it when the model is intentionally suppressed for age suitability.
test_case: Check that single-model prompts preserve either the selected hijab or no-hijab state.

area: Auto model untuk tudung kanak-kanak memilih umur dewasa
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: auto_prompt_model_defaults() only treated child products in fashion and shoes as child-model cases. A child hijab product stayed in the generic hijab branch, selecting an adult female model despite the child-product flag.
evidence: prompt_model_defaults.py:auto_prompt_model_defaults(); product category hijab and child_product=True.
effect: The default model age could be mismatched for a child-sized hijab product, even though the model was correctly set female with hijab.
recommended_action: Include hijab in the child-product age-fit branch; keep the model female and hijab-wearing for the hijab category while selecting age 8–12.
test_case: Add a regression test for child hijab category, gender, hijab and age defaults.

area: Subkategori dompet dan beg galas masih menggunakan adegan beg tangan generik
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: Auto style resolution recognized wallet/backpack subtypes, but _build_single_prompt() did not receive product_subtype and _category_specific_scenes() only saw the top-level category bag. A wallet could therefore receive handbag beats mentioning straps/handles; a backpack could miss its dedicated scene structure.
evidence: prompt_engine.py:build_prompt(), _build_single_prompt(), _category_specific_scenes().
effect: The chosen visual style and the storyboard's timed actions could disagree with the user's explicit bag subcategory.
recommended_action: Pass product_subtype into both split and single prompt paths; generate dedicated wallet and backpack five-beat scenes with safe no-invented-feature rules.
test_case: Regression tests assert a wallet selection never uses handbag scene beats and backpack scenes show actual straps only.

area: Arahan audio generik menyuruh tambah suara walaupun pengguna mungkin memilih tanpa dialog
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: _creative_variation() always said that if the video model could not create audio, add voice, music and SFX in post-production. This could conflict with prompt_creative_settings() saying 'No spoken dialogue.'
evidence: prompt_engine.py:_creative_variation() and bot.py:prompt_creative_settings() audio mode.
effect: A silent product video could receive contradictory instructions to add a voiceover.
recommended_action: Change fallback wording to add only audio elements explicitly selected by the user; keep music below any selected speech and SFX matched to visible action.
test_case: Regression test checks that audio variation no longer instructs unconditional voiceover.

area: Pilihan framing produk sahaja bercanggah dengan arahan model dan aksi
status: Patched in PR #131; latest CI pending
finding: The product_only framing direction forbids people, hands, faces and body parts, but prompt_creative_settings() still appended a human/animal model when that was selected earlier, and the creative variation could still request handling. The last-added settings could contradict the selected framing.
evidence: bot.py: prompt generation block applying PRODUCT_FRAMING and prompt_creative_settings().
effect: A prompt intended to show the product alone could include a model or hands due to earlier action/model instructions.
recommended_action: Make product_only framing override model selection, suppress the single-model head-covering addition, and append a final PRODUCT-ONLY PRIORITY instruction after all other settings.
test_case: Regression check verifies product-only model rules take precedence and the final override is present.
